+name: Hepta scoped disk admission exact-host smoke
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/blocking-ci.yml"
+      - ".github/workflows/hepta-scoped-disk-admission.yml"
+      - "scripts/hepta_ci_scoped_disk.py"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: hepta-disk-admission-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  disk-qualification:
+    name: Hosted Linux source-bound capacity preflight (no test waiver)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
+      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact candidate without credentials
+        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Test SDK-path classification without deletion
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
+          import tempfile
+          from pathlib import Path
+          from hepta_ci_scoped_disk import safe_sdk_directory
+          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+              root = Path(directory)
+              assert safe_sdk_directory(root / "missing") is False
+              (root / "ordinary").mkdir()
+              assert safe_sdk_directory(root / "ordinary") is True
+              (root / "link").symlink_to("ordinary", target_is_directory=True)
+              try:
+                  safe_sdk_directory(root / "link")
+              except RuntimeError:
+                  pass
+              else:
+                  raise AssertionError("symlink cleanup candidate was accepted")
+          PY
+      - name: Physically reclaim unused SDKs and verify exact-source receipt
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_SHA"
+          python3 scripts/hepta_ci_scoped_disk.py --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/hepta-scoped-disk.json"
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          path = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "hepta-scoped-disk.json"
+          receipt = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+          assert receipt["source_sha"] == receipt["tested_sha"] == os.environ["SOURCE_SHA"]
+          assert receipt["status"] == "passed"
+          assert receipt["free_after_bytes"] >= receipt["minimum_free_bytes"]
+          assert all(
+              item["path"].startswith(("/usr/local/lib/android", "/usr/share/dotnet", "/opt/ghc", "/usr/local/.ghcup", "/usr/local/share/powershell"))
+              for item in receipt["removed_sdk_roots"]
+          )
+          print("Exact-host disk admission receipt verified")
+          PY
+      - name: Verify exact checkout retained without source mutation
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          git diff --check
+          git diff --exit-code
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
+      - name: Retain physical disk evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
+        with:
+          name: hepta-scoped-disk-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hepta-scoped-disk.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Fail-closed hosted Linux CI disk admission for exact-source native impact tests.
+
+Deletes ONLY literal, unused preinstalled SDK directories. Never deletes Git,
+Cargo, Bazel, V8, checkout, or test artifacts. Writes a machine-readable receipt
+outside the source tree and requires sufficient free disk before expensive work.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import platform
+import re
+import shutil
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+# This job compiles Rust on Ubuntu, not Android, .NET, Haskell or PowerShell.
+# No directory or removal target is supplied by a PR author through CLI/env.
+UNUSED_HOSTED_SDK_ROOTS = (
+    Path("/usr/local/lib/android"),
+    Path("/usr/share/dotnet"),
+    Path("/opt/ghc"),
+    Path("/usr/local/.ghcup"),
+    Path("/usr/local/share/powershell"),
+)
+MINIMUM_FREE_BYTES = 12 * 1024**3
+
+
+def run(*arguments: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(
+        arguments, check=True, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE
+    )
+
+
+def safe_sdk_directory(root: Path) -> bool:
+    """Return False for an absent root; reject symlinks and unexpected types."""
+    for candidate in (root, *root.parents):
+        if candidate == Path("/"):
+            break
+        if candidate.is_symlink():
+            raise RuntimeError(f"refusing symlink SDK path: {candidate}")
+    try:
+        metadata = root.lstat()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return False
+    if not stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"refusing non-directory SDK path: {root}")
+    return True
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--receipt", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true" or platform.system() != "Linux":
+        parser.error("capacity reclamation is restricted to hosted GitHub Linux CI")
+    source_sha = os.environ.get("SOURCE_SHA", "")
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source_sha) is None:
+        parser.error("SOURCE_SHA must be a bound exact Git SHA")
+    workspace = Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"]).resolve(strict=True)
+    receipt = args.receipt.absolute()
+    if not receipt.is_absolute() or receipt.is_relative_to(workspace):
+        parser.error("receipt must be an absolute path outside the checked out source")
+    tested_sha = run("git", "-C", str(workspace), "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
+    if tested_sha != source_sha:
+        parser.error("checked-out commit differs from the bound source SHA")
+
+    evidence: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "source_sha": source_sha,
+        "tested_sha": tested_sha,
+        "workspace": str(workspace),
+        "minimum_free_bytes": MINIMUM_FREE_BYTES,
+        "free_before_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(workspace).free,
+        "removed_sdk_roots": [],
+        "status": "running",
+    }
+    try:
+        removed = []
+        for root in UNUSED_HOSTED_SDK_ROOTS:
+            if not safe_sdk_directory(root):
+                continue
+            disk_bytes = int(run("sudo", "du", "-sB1", "--", str(root)).stdout.split()[0])
+            run("sudo", "rm", "-rf", "--one-file-system", "--", str(root))
+            if root.exists() or root.is_symlink():
+                raise RuntimeError(f"SDK root remains after cleanup: {root}")
+            removed.append({"path": str(root), "du_bytes": disk_bytes})
+        run("sudo", "apt-get", "clean")
+        free_after = shutil.disk_usage(workspace).free
+        evidence.update(
+            removed_sdk_roots=removed,
+            free_after_bytes=free_after,
+            released_bytes=free_after - int(evidence["free_before_bytes"]),
+        )
+        if free_after < MINIMUM_FREE_BYTES:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"insufficient native CI disk: {free_after} bytes free; "
+                f"minimum {MINIMUM_FREE_BYTES}"
+            )
+        evidence["status"] = "passed"
+        return 0
+    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
+        evidence["status"] = "failed"
+        evidence["error"] = str(error)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        receipt.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        receipt.write_text(json.dumps(evidence, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        print(json.dumps(evidence, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
